name: ink-underline-draw
title: Ink Underline Draw
description: Link underline drawn like a felt-tip stroke: an SVG path whose stroke-dashoffset animates left-to-right with a hand-drawn wobble, thicker in the middle, retraced in reverse when the pointer leaves.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Humanist
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Hover Draw: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
